text:
ash: running through the quickstart docker sample and hitting "tenant_blocked". local node quickstart works, container shows vague "Tenant not authorized" UI.

marco: can you paste the response? is it from SDK or gateway?

ash: response body:
```json
{"error":"Tenant not authorized","code":"tenant_blocked","hint":null}
```

yui: that code usually means the request routed to an anonymous workspace that requires billing. do you have REDWOOD_ORG set in the container?

ash: i thought the image would load .env automatically. looks like my docker run omitted --env-file. container env has no REDWOOD_ORG.

infra-jon: yeah our quickstart image historically expects env injection. bad DX when anonymous routing returns non-actionable errors.

devex: proposed fixes: 1) quickstart entrypoint warns loudly if REDWOOD_ORG / WORKSPACE_ID missing and prints link to billing settings, 2) SDK maps tenant_blocked -> actionable hint when no org header.

marco: SDK change example: if response.code == 'tenant_blocked' and no X-Redwood-Org then error = "Workspace may be billing-locked. Set REDWOOD_ORG or X-Redwood-Org or visit https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/<id>/billing"

infra-jon: quick patch for entrypoint:
```bash
if [ -z "$REDWOOD_ORG" ]; then
  echo "⚠️ REDWOOD_ORG not set. Quickstart will hit anonymous routing which can be billing-gated. See https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces"
fi
```

yui: also add a short onboarding note in the README and small tweak to the welcome email so customers know firstcall may be blocked until billing is set.

billing-bot: Notice: workspace wz-4f1 requires billing contact. Admins visit https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/wz-4f1/billing to add payment/contact info.

ash: thanks — setting REDWOOD_ORG in my docker run fixed it. please prioritise the hint changes, this will save a lot of confusion for new users. :raised_hands:

devex: filing tasks: quickstart-docker-env-check, sdk-tenant-block-hint. assigning PRs to infra-jon and marco.

marco: i'll add a unit test that asserts the new SDK message when header missing. low risk.

infra-jon: PR incoming for entrypoint + README note.

ash: closing loop — container now works after env fix.
